back: A plan in figures of the expected income and costs of a farm or enterprise for a future period.
Costs that change with enterprise size and belong to one enterprise: seed, fertiliser, feed, chemicals, casual labour, transport.
Costs shared by the whole farm that do not change with enterprise size in the short term: rent, depreciation, permanent wages, insurance, interest.
Gross output (yield × price) − variable costs; per ha or per head.
Net change = (extra income + costs saved) − (extra costs + income lost).
Net farm income = total gross margin − fixed costs.
Plan and compare enterprises, know cash needs, obtain credit, control the season, reduce risk.
Own records, AGRITEX officers, farm management handbooks, input suppliers, buyers and marketing boards, banks, other farmers.
Fixed costs, rotation benefits, risk, labour peaks and cash timing.
